title: Person: Stephen
html_source:
This passage is marked in the Open Editions semantic edition as a person name.

Stephen

anchor.prefix:
ther fellows and said:

 —O, I say, here’s a fellow says he kisses his mother every night before he goes to bed.

 The other fellows stopped their game and turned round, laughing.
anchor.suffix:
blushed under their eyes and said:

 —I do not.

 Wells said:

 —O, I say, here’s a fellow says he doesn’t kiss his mother before he goes to bed.

 They all laughed again. Stephen
